fixed.problem: W15-01: two projects linked to one repository with the status pull request on. The second project's session pushed its status onto fr/status, which is one branch per repository, so it landed in the first project's open status PR #5. It also commented there, and its Overview listed #5 with Merge. The docs scaffold had the same gap for another project's open fr/docs-scaffold PR.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/loop-docs.test.ts 'w15-merge, wave 15' (4 cases); apps/ui/test/real-daemon.test.ts 'w15-merge, wave 15' (two projects through real sessions on one fake-GitHub repository, then the daemon composed again on the same home; fr/status head moved before the fix)
fixed.how: Status and scaffold PR bodies now end in a hidden mark `<!-- forerunner:pr project=<id> -->` (forerunnerMarker / readForerunnerMarker). checkout's `ours` option keeps the copy off a branch whose open PR belongs to another project, so nothing is pushed or commented and that status stays in the app with one log line. An unmarked PR counts as a project's only while that project is the one project of the install linked to the repository (soleLinkedProject; it counts every project and fails closed). The Overview docs rows and the Docs tab use the same rule. I built only the safety part: there is no per-project branch and no second PR, because owner question W15-112 is still open.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Link projects A and B to the same repository, with 'Status pull request' on in both. Run a session in A: its status PR opens. Then run a session in B. On GitHub, A's status PR has no new commit and no comment from B. B's Overview does not list A's status PR or A's docs PR. Bench: the second project's Overview reads 'No pull request waits for you.' while the first lists its own docs PR #1 (steps 01/02).

fixed.problem: W15-02 (data loss): a person who committed in a done task's folder while its rebuild was owed lost that commit at the next poll, with no word said.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/dependent-branches-merge.test.ts 'w15-merge, wave 15' > 'a commit the person makes ... never dropped by a rebuild', '... pushed to GitHub, as the sentence offers', and 'a rebuild whose push failed is rebuilt at the next poll'
fixed.how: folderHold(git, branch, base) holds the rebuild (held: 'commits') whenever the task's branch or the folder's HEAD has a commit that GitHub's branch lacks. Forerunner's own unpushed states are exempt: the base-merge shape and WIP commits. Any commit it cannot identify holds the rebuild, so it fails closed. If Forerunner's own rebuild never reached GitHub, it is put back: immediately when the push fails (putBack), or at the next try after a crash (REBUILD_PENDING_REF / REBUILD_BEFORE_*). The poll writes the wait on the record (DependentBranches.sayFolderWait, last_outcome owed_folder_commits). A plain wait gets its words back once the folder is clean (folderWaitOver).
fixed.check_in_the_app: Run a chain A <- B on a repository project. Commit a file in B's task folder (the path shown under B's row). Squash-merge A on GitHub. Within one poll, B's Overview row reads '#N waits for a commit made in its task's folder: push it to GitHub or undo it.' and offers no Merge, and `git log` in the folder still has the commit. Push it: the next poll rebuilds B and keeps the commit.

fixed.problem: W15-03: in a chain A <- B <- C where B changes A's file, B's folder was busy when A was squash-merged. C got a false rebuild-conflict card and sentence with no Merge, and kept them after B and C were rebuilt cleanly.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/dependent-branches-merge.test.ts 'w15-merge, wave 15: a chain with a busy middle (W15-03)'
fixed.how: A task that comes after one whose rebuild could not run cleanly in this pass (STUCK_REBUILDS: busy, held, failed, conflict, waits) gets result 'waits' and stays owed, so R-lock keeps its merge waiting. It follows once the middle is rebuilt. A clean rebuild with the same own change on a record that says rebuild_conflict restores the plain wait and withdraws the rebuild card (closeRebuildConflictCard). The same conflict tried again does not file a second card.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Run a chain A <- B <- C where B edits A's file. Keep B running while A is squash-merged on GitHub. C gets no 'could not be rebuilt' card. Once B is rebuilt, C follows, and C's row offers Merge with 'Accepted · waiting for you to merge'.

fixed.problem: W15-04: Redo on the Tasks row of a task with a conflict notice open resumed the old branch and hit a rebase conflict, which filed a second card. The notice also stayed open after the PR later merged cleanly.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/dependent-branches-merge.test.ts 'w15-merge, wave 15: the Tasks tab's Redo on a task with a conflict notice (W15-04)'
fixed.how: task.reopen of a done task now withdraws its open merge card in the same transaction (redoneMergeCard in loop/merge-mode.ts, which the card's own Redo applyRedo also uses). The next run therefore starts from main, and no rebase-conflict card follows. It starts no session; the owner question on Tasks-row actions is still open. closeStaleNotice closes a notice whose record has moved on once GitHub says the PR merges cleanly. A notice that takes over an earlier notice card keeps that card's earlier words.
fixed.check_in_the_app: With a 'conflicts with main' notice open in the Inbox for a done task, press Redo on its Tasks row. The notice leaves the Inbox. Start a session: the task runs from main and no second conflict card appears. After its PR merges, no notice stays open.

fixed.problem: W15-05: with a file left in B's task folder while B owed a rebuild, the row offered a bare Merge before the press. The press answered 'Merging #23.' and nothing merged, and the sentence never said where the folder is.
fixed.failing_test_before: apps/ui/test/real-daemon.test.ts 'w15-merge, wave 15: a merge that waits for its task's folder (W15-05)' (sessions, one poll, press, daemon composed again, folder cleaned, merge goes on); apps/ui/test/project-overview.test.tsx 'w15-merge, wave 15'
fixed.how: The poll writes the wait on the record (W15-02), so the row says it before any press, with canMerge false. ProjectPullRequestView gains `folder` (ReviewedPrMerge.worktreeOf), which the Overview shows with FolderPath. The press checks the folder at that moment (folderWaitNow), approves (approveInOrder keeps the wait's sentence) and answers with the wait sentence instead of 'Merging #N.'. Once the folder is clean, the next poll rebuilds and the kept approval merges. The fake daemon answers the same way.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Bench walk (fix-w15-merge, 13/13 checks): a chain A <- B on bench/seeded, notes.txt left in B's folder, A squash-merged. B's Overview row reads '#3 waits for changes left in its task's folder: take them out or redo the task.', shows the folder path with Copy path, and offers no Merge. The Tasks row reads 'Accepted · merge waits for you'. After notes.txt was removed, B merged by itself (steps 03-06).

fixed.problem: W15-06: answering the rebase-conflict card 'I resolved it' or 'Drop the branch and retry from scratch' left the task Ready with no session. The card title was its 'why' cut mid-sentence, the Done line was a bare echo, and the last step promised to open a PR that already existed.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/capabilities/test/pr-executor.test.ts 'w15-merge, wave 15' > 'the rebase-conflict card with a pull request open says its last step updates it ...' and "'I resolved it' and 'Drop the branch ...' each start one session ..."
fixed.how: applyRebaseAnswer starts or queues a session through resumeWork and records it with recordStart; Cancel starts nothing. request-words.ts gains rebaseConflictCard / rebaseConflictOutcome: title '"T" conflicts with main', a body naming the files, one-line explanations per option, and Done lines from the outcome. The step text says 'updates #N' when a PR is open. The card carries pr_number, task_title and again.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Make a task's branch conflict with main in a way the agent cannot resolve. The Inbox card is titled '"<task>" conflicts with main' and names the files. Answer 'I resolved it': the Done line says '"<task>" goes on with your resolution: a session started.' and a session runs. The same holds for 'Drop the branch', which does the task again from main.

Sentences changed (for w15-words). head moved: '... then merge it yourself or send it back.' -> '... then merge it yourself or redo the task.' (headMovedWords, loop/merge.ts). emptied: 'Redone from main, it changed nothing, so #4 was closed.' -> 'The redo from main changed nothing, so #4 was closed.'; 'It changed nothing and #4 held no change, so #4 was closed.' -> 'The last run changed nothing and #4 held no change, so it was closed.'; 'main already has this change.' -> 'The main branch already has this change.'. Up-to-date PR comment -> 'This task's work no longer changes anything on main, so this pull request is closed. Its branch is kept.'. PR body -> 'Opened by Forerunner in the session started YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM UTC.' plus a hidden mark; comment -> 'Updated in the session started ...:'. Status commit -> 'docs: status after the session started ...'; status body -> 'Status update of the session started ...:'.

New sentences and labels: owedCommitSentence '#N waits for a commit made in its task's folder: push it to GitHub or undo it.'; unreachable 'GitHub did not answer about #N: Forerunner tries the merge again.' with Tasks label 'Accepted · merges once GitHub answers'; LEFT_TO_YOU_LABELS in daemon/task-words.ts (one label per merge outcome); rebase-conflict card words in daemon/request-words.ts rebaseConflictCard / rebaseConflictOutcome (title '"T" conflicts with main').

Hidden PR mark: forerunnerMarker / readForerunnerMarker / sessionWords are exported from packages/capabilities/src/githost/pr-executor.ts (`<!-- forerunner:pr project=<id> task=<id> session=<id> -->`, URI-encoded). loop/docs.ts exports isProjectDocsPr(project, pr, {soleLinked}), isProjectStatusPr and soleLinkedProject. Anything listing a project's PRs should use them.

loop/merge-mode.ts new exports: OWED_FOLDER_COMMITS, owedCommitSentence, OWED_FOLDER_OUTCOMES, owedFolderWait(pr, held), waitsForYourMergeSentence, plainWaitForYou, folderWaitOver, MERGE_CARD_KEY, REDO_FROM_BASE, redoneMergeCard(card, nowIso). owedMergeWait now also covers left_to_you records.
